location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the coin comes when it is done, and anything carried home is the company's
stakeIfLost: If Edrasa is not returned, the loggers will seize the winter wood and the fort will be left without its fuel supply.
arrival: came in with the day's callers · spoke low, and only to the boss
OPPOSES: herbalist · keep the forest's judgment intact by guarding the beast

cast.name: Edrasa Palebough
cast.who: A lean, lone elf who ran small trade wagons through the Western Forests.

bible.goal: To bring the accused Edrasa Palebough alive to the fort for questioning.

relevantLore.name: Harrowoak Clearing
relevantLore.blurb: A ring of fallen pines and a scorched floor where fires ran into the old growth.

arcStep: Go to the loggers' winter huts the fort named to look for the accused Edrasa Palebough
